name: George Burgers
notes: Router was null (no website on record). No own website found by search; only ordering-platform storefronts exist. Address-confirmed via DoorDash's store page FAQ block ("George Burgers is located at 350 N Broadway, Escondido, CA 92025") matching the work list's 350 North Broadway exactly. DoorDash's own store page (george-burgers-escondido-171661) carries a full schema.org Menu JSON-LD (91 items) but FAILS the markup test hard: 13/13 sampled prices divide cleanly by 1.20 onto round or half-dollar values (e.g. $8.40/1.2=$7.00, $10.80/1.2=$9.00, $6.30/1.2=$5.25) with zero exceptions - a uniform 20% delivery surcharge, so DoorDash was not used. Uber Eats' store page (same address city "San Diego" region tag but title confirms "George Burgers") returned 200 with real content (title tag: "George Burgers | Menu | San Diego | Uber Eats"); menu data pulled from __REACT_QUERY_STATE__ (quotes escaped as literal \u0022, unescaped before parsing catalogItems by regex since the outer blob contains an unrelated doubly-escaped metaJson sub-string that breaks a full JSON.parse). Uber Eats prices end almost entirely in .99/.49/.50 (51 of 54 sampled end in .99) with no divisor (1.04/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3/0.96) producing a round-number cluster - passes the markup test, so used as the source despite being a delivery marketplace rather than the restaurant's own site. Uber Eats and DoorDash list overlapping but not identical items at different absolute prices (e.g. Hot Dog $2.99 vs $3.00-equivalent, Onion Rings $2.99 vs $4.80/1.2=$4.00) - not used as a cross-check per the rule that disagreement is information, not corroboration. 107 dishes across 16 sections (George's Combo Meals, Burgers, Sandwiches, Deli Sandwiches, Melts, Hot Dogs, Plate, Pita's, Fresh Salads, Mexican Burritos, Mexican Quesadillas, Kids Mains, Sides, Drinks, Shakes, Salad Wraps) - matches the cuisine and popular-items description (Cheeseburger, Gyro, Greek/Mexican items, kids menu) found via WebSearch summaries of aggregator pages. None inferred, merged, divided, or truncated.
